description: Source code implementing ARMv7 NEON assembly routines for AES encryption/decryption, key schedule, and related transformations, adapted from x86_64 and ARMv8 implementations, with constants and functions for vectorized AES operations.

methods.name: _aes_preheat
methods.description: Initializes vector registers with constants for AES operations.

methods.name: _vpaes_encrypt_core
methods.description: Performs core AES encryption on vector register q0.

methods.name: _vpaes_decrypt_core
methods.description: Performs core AES decryption on vector register q0.

methods.name: _vpaes_schedule_core
methods.description: Generates round keys for AES key schedule.

methods.name: _vpaes_schedule_transform
methods.description: Applies linear transformation to key schedule vectors.

methods.name: _vpaes_schedule_mangle
methods.description: Transforms key schedule vectors for encryption/decryption basis.

methods.name: vpaes_encrypt
methods.description: Encrypts a block of data using AES with vectorized ARM NEON instructions.

methods.name: vpaes_decrypt
methods.description: Decrypts a block of data using AES with vectorized ARM NEON instructions.

methods.name: vpaes_set_encrypt_key
methods.description: Sets up AES encryption key schedule.

methods.name: vpaes_set_decrypt_key
methods.description: Sets up AES decryption key schedule.

methods.name: vpaes_encrypt_key_to_bsaes
methods.description: Converts vpaes key schedule to bsaes format.

methods.name: vpaes_decrypt_key_to_bsaes
methods.description: Converts bsaes key schedule to vpaes format.

methods.name: vpaes_ctr32_encrypt_blocks
methods.description: Performs AES CTR mode encryption on multiple blocks.
